title: Inference microbench scratchpad
raw_notes:
Quick scratchpad for microbench runs — personal tracker.

Observations:
- q4_0 gives good median but unstable tails when seq > 256 (see exp-20241106-B, exp-20241218-E).
- batch 32 showed throughput wins but p95 jumps (exp-20250127-G). suspect KV cache eviction behavior.
- single V100 OOM on 13b q4_0 (exp-20250109-F) — try model-sliced inference or smaller batch; schedule multi-GPU test.

To-do / next steps:
- Reproduce exp-20241106-B p95 spike with tracing on (trace-id: run-b-p95).
- Add columns for mem_peak_mb and gpu_util_pct next run.
- Try q4_1 on community-13b to compare quality/cost.
- Link perf trace to GH-PR-4521 once available.

Loose ideas and notes-to-self:
- Could add ultra-fast path toggles in serving runtime for seq < 64.
- Remind SRE to reserve a multi-GPU A100 slot for 2h on 2025-02-10.

References: JIRA-INF-998 (batching investigation), confluence:inference-kernels-eval (kernel perf notes).

Random scraps:
- "Need to check tokenizer differences across model variants (byte-pair vs unigram)"
- "Try repacking prompts to reduce avg tokens_in by 10%"
summary: Personal one-page sheet tracking small-scale inference experiments. Mix of numeric rows (latency/cost) and quick freeform notes. Used for quick decisions: reruns, triage, and scheduling multi-GPU windows.
format_notes: Rows are CSV strings in sheet_data. Each row = one run. Use exp_id to reference back to traces and GH/JIRA items. This file intentionally informal — rough numbers, quick flags, todo checklist.
